content:
rachel: Drafting a concise RN for tonight's runtime rollout. Paste + quick review for pin/rollback language.

rachel: TL;DR: runtime v2.4.3 with kernel selection bugfix, KV-cache reuse improvement, and batching tweak. Hosted + dedicated impacted. No model weights or model version changes.

rachel: Proposed internal snippet:
```
Heads-up: Rolling runtime v2.4.3 at 01:30 UTC. Expected: lower tail latency on long-context requests. Canary: 4% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> full if green. Dedicated pools pinned to runtime:v2.4.3 during window.
Rollback triggers: >=3 OOMs in same region within 5m OR error rate >1.8% for 5m OR P95 +35% for 10m -> rollback to v2.4.2.
If rollback: `./ops/rollback-runtime --to v2.4.2` and notify #eng-sre + #support.
Support: support+dedicated@redwood.ai. QA smoke: https://qa.internal/runs/659-smoke (owner: tyler).
```

tyler: please add note that node-heavy accounts are held back until 25% phase.

rachel: added. Also: will copy to #staff-announce 30m before deploy.

eng-sre-bot: [deploy scheduled] runtime:v2.4.3 -> rolling canary at 2026-12-02T01:30:00Z; owner: rachel; plan: 4% x15m -> 25% x30m -> full. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/6590012345

nora: ops checklist looks good. Add `./ops/hold-deploy --release 6590012345` as manual pause.

rachel: done. Final RN posted and pinned in #eng-releases. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
